message.content:
In December, Los Angeles enjoys mild winter weather. On average:

| Metric | Value |
|--------|-------|
| Average high | ~18 °C (≈64 °F) |
| Average low | ~10 °C (≈50 °F) |
| Daily mean (average of high & low) | ~14 °C (≈57 °F) |

So if you’re looking for a single “average temperature” figure, it’s roughly **14 °C (57 °F)** for the month. The city rarely sees temperatures below freezing, and daytime highs are usually comfortable for outdoor activities.
